categories.main_business_segments: The company operates department store-type discount stores, primarily selling off-season and planned clothing brand products at discounted prices. It also offers food, daily necessities, and convenience facilities such as cultural and sports centers, providing a one-stop shopping experience. Additionally, the company has expanded into travel-related services through the merger with its subsidiary Tour Cabin, offering travel package marketplaces and customized travel services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s operations are based on retail management and merchandising strategies rather than manufacturing technologies. It focuses on buying and selling branded clothing, food, and daily goods, utilizing store renewal and location analysis for operational efficiency. The travel business leverages an online marketplace platform and mobile app development to meet customer needs.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are middle and lower-income consumers seeking affordable branded clothing and daily necessities. The company targets local residential areas with large apartment complexes, focusing on regional, community-based retail markets. The travel segment serves customers looking for convenient package and customized travel services.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates six retail stores located mainly in the Seoul metropolitan area and other regional cities including Seoul (Nowon), Gyeonggi Province (Seongnam, Gwangmyeong, Bucheon), Daejeon, and Jeonju. It also owns and operates cultural and sports centers in Goyang and Seoul. The travel business is nationwide, accessible via online platforms.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the downstream retail segment, purchasing products directly or hosting brand tenants who sell through its stores. It acts as a retailer and service provider, with no upstream manufacturing involvement. The travel business functions as a marketplace intermediary between travel product suppliers and consumers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include defending offline retail sales amid growing online competition by enhancing store appeal and cost efficiency. The company invests in store renewals and facility improvements to attract customers. In travel services, it focuses on platform upgrades and mobile app development to expand market reach and maximize sales through multiple channels.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of clothing, food, and daily goods, including direct sales and commission fees from brand tenants. Additional income comes from rental and service fees related to cultural and sports centers. The travel segment earns revenue from travel package sales and related service fees.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In the department store-type discount retail sector, the company faces competition from major players like Lotte, Shinsegae, and Hyundai in metropolitan areas. Regionally, it competes with local department stores and large marts such as E-Mart and Homeplus. The company holds a niche position focusing on mid-to-low income consumers with a differentiated mall-type outlet format.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, the company reported annual sales of approximately 123.8 billion KRW, a 3.7% increase from the previous year, with operating profit rising nearly 20% to 11 billion KRW and net profit increasing 48% to 13.6 billion KRW. Total assets stand at about 585 billion KRW with a stable debt ratio around 23%. The company shows steady growth despite challenging market conditions.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself by offering a department store-type discount shopping experience combining affordable branded clothing with food and lifestyle products under one roof. It emphasizes regional market penetration with stores located in residential areas, providing convenience and value to middle and lower-income consumers. The integration of cultural and sports facilities enhances customer engagement and loyalty.
